scope: Final observer: local 4-rank J4/J6 correctness and accounting, not performance evidence. Checked run has runtime checks/traps and oracles off; cluster retains both complete checked modes.

workflow.scope: Same observer and outer workflow boundaries. Max is selected once per step, not independently per phase. Transaction 1 is WT_after_step; transaction 2 is implementation-specific tendency preparation and must not be assumed equivalent. Local event clocks are not synchronized across ranks.

operations.scope: Only dynamics. WT and outside_WT are disjoint; tendency tag is nested diagnostic only. Self time conserves each rank/context. MPI may include progress/arrival waits. Group names do not establish equivalent numerical work or avoidable cost.
